jordan_user: Hi — trying to redeem a promo code sent by our partner, shows 'invalid/expired' when I redeem it in the console. Code is HOLIDAY-PARTNER-2025. Tried twice.
emma_support: Sorry about that — I can look. Is this the account email jordan@example.com? Any chance you pasted extra characters?
jordan_user: Yes, that's the account. I pasted from Slack — should be exact. I'm in Auckland (NZDT). Partner told me expiry is 2025-12-01.
emma_support: Thanks. Can you try typing it manually and also via the API? If API, can you paste the curl you used?
jordan_user: Tried manual too. API call: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." \
  -d '{"code":"HOLIDAY-PARTNER-2025"}'
```
Response: `{ "error": "promo_invalid_or_expired", "message": "code invalid or expired" }`
emma_support: Got it. I'm going to escalate and check the promo table. Giving a quick manual credit momentarily.
ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2025-4321 - Promo redemption failure spike.
kevin_engineer: Jumping in — can you confirm the promo id (if you have it) or I can search by code string. Also any headers from the API response (x-server-time)?
emma_support: Found promo row: id=prm_98ac, code value matches, expiry_ts=1765344000 (UTC) on DB. Looks like expiry is 2024-06-09 00:00:00 UTC actually. Partner's docs show 2025-12-01 — mismatch.
jordan_user: That's surprising. Partner sent email claiming 12/01/2025. Could they have issued a different batch?
sara_billing: Checked upstream promo issuance feed: two batches. The partner batch we ingested had an incorrect expiry set due to a CSV where the date was 12/01/24 and ingestor parsed MM/DD/YY vs DD/MM/YY. So promo was set to 2024 not 2025.
jordan_user: Ahh ok that explains it. But partner insists they sent 12/01/25. They might have used dd/mm/yyyy in email.
emma_support: For immediate fix: I applied a manual $200 credit to jordan@example.com (txn id tx_2025_manual_77). Can you confirm you see the credit?
jordan_user: I see the credit, thank you. :relieved:
kevin_engineer: Root cause also surfaced another data issue: some partners include zero-width space (U+200B) when copying from marketing. Our normalizer didn't strip ZWSP which made some user-entered codes fail if they copy/pasted with invisible chars. I've filed BUG-PRM-559 to trim invisible chars on redeem path, and DATA-INGEST-342 to validate date formats on ingestion.
emma_support: Notes for ops: 1) manual credit applied, 2) created refund/credit metadata linking to promo id prm_98ac, 3) asked partner ops to reissue corrected batch.
sara_billing: Partner notified, new feed requested. We'll regenerate corrected promo codes and set expiry to 2025-12-01 UTC. Also added CSV schema validation to ingestion.
jordan_user: Thanks all. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
emma_support: Glad it's sorted. Leaving this thread open until partner confirms reissue. If you notice anything else, ping me. :thumbsup:
